name: add_axum_query_filter
description: Adds ANDed category/price filtering across repository and handler
prompts: GET /products returns all products. Add optional filtering across both layers: (1) in src/repository.rs, add a method search(&self, category: Option<&str>, max_price: Option<i64>) -> Vec<Product> to ProductRepository - category filters by exact match when Some, max_price is an INCLUSIVE upper bound when Some, both None returns everything, order preserved; (2) in src/handlers.rs, accept optional `category` and `maxPrice` query parameters on GET /products (an axum Query extractor over a struct with Option fields; note the camelCase maxPrice name needs a serde rename) and call repo.search. Combining filters ANDs them. Keep the Product JSON shape.

setup_files.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "webapp"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
axum = "0.7"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"

[dev-dependencies]
tower = { version = "0.5", features = ["util"] }
